title: Sanjhbati
desc: An elderly woman struggles with her difficult nature and isolated life. When a new caretaker arrives, their relationship faces challenges, developing into a story about connection and companionship.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Cheetah
desc: Jamal, a gangster, kills Amar's family. To everyone's surprise, the latter survives, wakes from a coma and seeks revenge.

title: Jwar Bhata
desc: Bijay, a rich tea estate owner's son, angers his father when he marries a poor girl. Ranjan, his cousin, tries to make the most of the situation by usurping his property.

title: Satarupa
desc: Dr. Rupa unintentionally causes Shatadal's memory loss, leading him to see her as his only kin. Later, they fall for each other but when his past returns, he forgets her.

title: Agnipath
desc: Sujay, Ajay and Bijay are three siblings who share a close bond and can go to any length to protect each other. However, when Sujay is killed by his own boss, Bijay sets out to exact revenge.

title: Bandie
desc: Unable to conceive an heir, Maharaja Brajbhan and his wife are forced to abdicate the throne for his cousin, Vikram. Chaos ensues when Vikram learns that the queen is pregnant and decides to kill her.

title: Prosenjit Weds Rituparna
desc: Rituparna, a fan of Prosenjit, marries a man with the same name. Her husband, who dislikes his famous namesake, falls for her and attempts to arrange a meeting between his wife and Prosenjit.

title: Saheber Cutlet
desc: A chef wants to open his restaurant in Paris by selling his ancestral house. However, it's not an easy task as he learns his family members are not ready to leave the house.

title: Patanjali Yog - By Yogrishi Swami Ramdev
desc: Baba Ramdev emphasises the importance of yoga and demonstrates various asanas and breathing exercises that enable one to lead a healthy and stress-free life.

title: Sultan: The Saviour
desc: Raja Dutta and his sister Disha move to Kolkata to start afresh. But Disha is oblivious to Raja's past and his intention behind shifting to Kolkata.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Tor Naam
desc: Tor Naam is a sweet teenage love story which begins in a boarding school in Sikkim and ends with an interesting twist.

title: Sindoor Niye Khela
desc: Varsha is a powerful businesswoman, but faces opposition from her workers. In order to solve the problem, she marries the leader of the workers' union.

title: Satyam Shivam Sundaram
desc: Laxmi, a milkmaid, falls in love with Kanchan, an influential zamindar's son. Things take a tragic turn when his family disapproves of their alliance.

title: Ekai Eksho
desc: Ratan, an honest autorickshaw driver, refuses to help a corrupt politician, Pradip Roy, which then leads to a local war. He also ends up falling in love with Jhilik, his daughter.

title: Sathihara
desc: Musicians Anuradha and Jeet fall in love and marry, but their relationship is tested when Anuradha's thriving career begins to overshadow Jeet's ambitions.

title: Ogo Bodhu Shundori
desc: Tensions rise between a married couple with conflicting personalities as the husband offers shelter to a woman in their home.
